pullingModels.label: Pulling
pullingModels.description: Bow/crossbow: models while drawing – usually 3 stages.

fireworkModel.label: Charged with a firework
fireworkModel.description: Crossbow: loaded with a firework rocket (optional).

blockingModel.label: Blocking
blockingModel.hint: Instead of the SHIELD material, the “Blocks Attacks” component can be used from 1.21.5 on.

throwingModel.label: Throwing
throwingModel.description: Trident: while winding up to throw – usually the rotated main model.
throwingModel.hint: Set the look in flight, damage and sounds under “Mechanics → Trident”.

damagedModels.label: Damaged
damagedModels.description: Models shown one after another as durability decreases.
damagedModels.hint: The item needs durability (a material with durability or the “Max Damage” component).

dyeableModel.label: Dyed
dyeableModel.description: Model shown when the item has been dyed (/nexo dye).
dyeableModel.hint: For dyeing, the faces in the model must have “Tint” enabled (Blockbench: Paint tab → Tint).

compositeModels.label: Layered models
compositeModels.description: Several models drawn on top of each other (e.g. background, item, overlay).

guiModel.label: Inventory icon
guiModel.description: A different model in the inventory (e.g. a flat 2D image), while the main model is shown in hand, on the head or as furniture.
guiModel.hint: ResourcepackBuilder generates its own ItemModel for this (Minecraft 1.21.4+). Pulling, Blocking and the like then no longer apply.

connectStraight.label: Straight
connectStraight.description: Middle piece between the left and right end

placementFloor.label: Floor
placementFloor.description: Placed on top of a block

placementWall.label: Wall
placementWall.description: Attached to the side of a block

lightOn.label: Toggled (Light On)
lightOn.description: Model when the light is switched on

stackModels.label: Stackable
stackModels.description: Additional models when the same block is placed several times in one spot (like pink petals).

brokenModel.label: Broken
brokenModel.description: Model shown while the item is broken (one durability point left).
brokenModel.hint: The item needs durability. Nexo builds a condition item model on the broken property from it. Read by Nexo 1.30, not listed in the docs.

dirY.label: Upright (y)
dirY.description: Face model of a LOG standing upright

dirX.label: Along x
dirX.description: Face model of a LOG lying along the x axis

dirZ.label: Along z
dirZ.description: Face model of a LOG lying along the z axis

dirNorth.label: North
dirNorth.description: Face model of the block facing north

dirSouth.label: South
dirSouth.description: Face model of the block facing south

dirEast.label: East
dirEast.description: Face model of the block facing east

dirWest.label: West
dirWest.description: Face model of the block facing west

dirUp.label: Up
dirUp.description: Face model of the block facing up

dirDown.label: Down
dirDown.description: Face model of the block facing down
